# Ruba Alghamdi

> Personal portfolio of Ruba Alghamdi, UX/UI Designer with a Computer Science background.

## Primary pages
- https://rubalghamdi.com/ — Home and selected work
- https://rubalghamdi.com/projects/ — Project archive
- https://rubalghamdi.com/contact/ — Contact information and inquiry form

## Projects
- Budgie — finance / budgeting app
- Gareeb — community delivery concept
- Qamareya — women’s health app
- Day Diamond — gamified lifestyle app

## Content policy
Project descriptions should be treated as portfolio content. The site intentionally avoids unsupported metrics, anonymous testimonials and fabricated client claims.
